sources.title: Copula-based trading of cointegrated cryptocurrency Pairs
sources.use: weekly reference-spread Copula selector with fixed train-only thresholds; no inherited return claim
sources.boundary: paper capital, sample, margin, funding and execution assumptions do not satisfy this repository's promotion contract

sources.title: Pair trading with high-frequency data in the cryptocurrency market
sources.use: pre-register fixed thresholds and use distance only as a return-blind tie-break/ranker after statistical admission
sources.boundary: entry, exit and pair-count sensitivity results prohibit post-result threshold tuning

sources.title: Improving Cointegration-Based Pairs Trading Strategy with Asymptotic Analyses and Convergence Rate Filters
sources.use: rank or veto slow expected convergence; do not add another hard admission AND gate
sources.boundary: the paper's Johansen/VECM family and threshold chosen from its own experiment are not imported

sources.title: Pairs trading with the persistence-based decomposition model
sources.use: decompose spread shocks into random-walk, finite AR(1), and noise components; only finite-persistence component may gate Martin FO/SO/TP
sources.boundary: paper's realistic restricted result is 9.16% annual return with 46.37% MDD; its 138.6% result removes execution constraints and is explicitly rejected as delay-zero bias

sources.title: Pairs-trading and spread persistence in the European stock market
sources.use: use persistence to rank fixed candidates, not to search outer returns

sources.title: Structural break-aware pairs trading strategy using deep reinforcement learning
sources.reason: black-box break detector and reinforcement learner add a large overfit surface; only the break-risk motivation is retained

sources.title: Deep learning-based pairs trading: real-time forecasting of co-integrated cryptocurrency pairs
sources.reason: transaction costs are not explicitly modeled, reported MDD is 28.75%, and DNN/LSTM dynamic weighting materially increases overfit and execution risk

sources.title: statsmodels.stats.diagnostic.breaks_cusumolsresid
sources.use: documents that the test is based on scaled cumulative OLS residuals and a Brownian-Bridge asymptotic distribution; it does not establish a HAC-adjusted crypto residual admission gate

search_conclusion: No public source found that simultaneously demonstrates Martin-only PnL, principal below 5000U, multi-coin shared-account execution, 50/90/100 percent annual targets, 10/20/30 percent equity drawdown, and reproducible realistic fills. Round 27 therefore tests mechanisms rather than inheriting headline returns.
